blocks.text: Sulfur ka bara hissa, taqreeban 85 feesad, sulfuric acid banane mein istemal hota hai. Molecule tetrahedral banawat rakhta hai jis mein do S-O (hydroxyl) aur do S=O bonds hain (Figure 12.11). Agle topics contact process se us ki tayyari, physical aur chemical khusoosiyat, aur istemalat bayan karte hain.

blocks.alt: Sulfuric acid ka structural formula: darmiyan mein sulfur, do double-bond wale oxygen aur do OH groups. Surkh dohre teer bond lengths batate hain: S=O 142.2 pm, S-O(H) 157.4 pm aur O-H 97 pm. Dabba kehta hai sulfur ke gird tarteeb tetrahedral hai, sulfur +6 hai, aur taqreeban 85% sulfur H2SO4 banane mein lagta hai.
blocks.caption: H2SO4 ki saakht (Figure 12.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Sulfuric acid ki banawat banayein aur us mein sulfur ki oxidation state dein (exercise Q.2j; MCQ IX).
blocks.explanation: Markazi sulfur chaar oxygens se tetrahedral taur par juri hai: do S=O ke taur par aur do S-OH. Hydrogen +1 aur oxygen -2 ke saath, 2 + S - 8 = 0, to sulfur +6 hai.

items: Taqreeban 85% sulfur H2SO4 mein jati hai; do S=O aur do S-OH bonds wala tetrahedral molecule; S +6 hai.
